categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of PMOLED display modules, lithium battery modules, and ozone-related products. It also engages in energy storage systems and provides SMT and electronic component services. Subsidiaries focus on high-efficiency lithium iron phosphate battery modules for energy storage and portable battery modules for smart devices. The company also develops ozone water generators and related sterilization products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes PMOLED technology with passive matrix OLED displays, focusing on high brightness, low power consumption, and customization. It integrates OLED with embedded touch solutions and develops Mini LED and Micro LED technologies. Battery modules are designed with modularity, safety protection circuits, and integration of power electronics and energy management systems. Ozone products employ patented gas-liquid mixing and negative pressure activation technologies to ensure effective ozone concentration and safety compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global brand manufacturers in consumer electronics, medical devices, industrial instruments, wearable devices, smart home products, and automotive applications. The company serves markets in China, the Americas, Taiwan, and Europe. End markets span consumer electronics, healthcare, industrial control, IoT, and renewable energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with sales extending to the Americas and Europe. Manufacturing and assembly are conducted in Taiwan and China, leveraging local supply chains and cost advantages. The company also collaborates with international partners for technology development and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of display modules and battery modules. It sources key components like ICs, glass substrates, and battery cells from upstream suppliers and delivers finished modules to downstream OEMs and brand customers. It also provides ODM and OEM services, integrating upstream materials into customized products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include diversifying product lines beyond PMOLED to TFT LCD, AMOLED, and EPD displays, and expanding energy storage business. R&D focuses on enhancing OLED efficiency, brightness, lifespan, and integrating touch functions. The company invests in Mini LED and Micro LED technologies and develops high-reliability automotive OLED components. It also advances ozone sterilization technologies and modular battery designs, aiming for innovation leadership and market differentiation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of display modules, lithium battery modules, and ozone sterilization devices. The company also earns income from OEM/ODM manufacturing services and leasing operations via subsidiaries. Investment income from subsidiaries and strategic partnerships contributes to overall revenue. The company does not disclose subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading PMOLED manufacturer globally, competing with a few major players in Taiwan and China. It holds the largest production capacity and advanced coating technology, providing superior brightness and power efficiency. Competitors include domestic and Chinese PMOLED makers and emerging AMOLED producers. The company differentiates through patent portfolios, customization capabilities, and cost-effective automated production, maintaining a strong market position in niche small-size displays.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue was approximately NT$2.3 billion, a 14.3% decrease from the prior year, with a net profit of NT$44.6 million reversing a prior loss. Total assets grew by 41.5% to NT$7.1 billion, and equity increased by 37.8% to NT$2.9 billion. The company invests about 6.5% of revenue in R&D, showing a commitment to innovation. Cash flow from operations remains positive, supported by capital increases and financing activities, indicating a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customizable PMOLED displays with superior brightness, low power consumption, and flexible form factors suitable for small-size applications. Its patented technologies and advanced manufacturing processes enable cost-effective production with enhanced product reliability. The integration of OLED with embedded touch and development of Mini/Micro LED displays provide competitive differentiation. In batteries, modular design and safety features cater to diverse applications, while ozone products offer environmentally friendly and effective sterilization solutions with certified safety standards.
